items.title: Aon nears around $17B deal to buy KKR-backed USI Insurance – WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- Aon is close to signing a deal with private equity firm KKR to buy Valhalla, NY-based insurance brokerage USI Insurance for around $17 billion including debt, according to a report from the Wall Street Journal on Sunday. Citing persons familiar with the matter, the report said that the deal could be announced as soon as Monday.

items.title: Aon Nears Roughly $17 Billion Deal for Insurance Brokerage USI
items.summary: Aon  is near an agreement to buy insurance brokerage USI Insurance from private-equity firm  KKR  for roughly $17 billion, including debt, according to people familiar with the matter.  USI, based in Valhalla, N.Y., is an insurance brokerage and consulting firm.  KKR acquired USI from the private-equity firm Onex in 2017 alongside the Canadian investment firm CDPQ for $4.3 billion.

items.title: Why Is Aon (AON) Combining Its Specialty Businesses Under One Brand?
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) plans to launch Totalis Specialty Group, combining NFP Totalis Program Underwriters and Aon Affinity’s U.S. programs business under one brand. The new unit will align specialty underwriting, program administration, and distribution under a single approach.
